title: Token Gateway
summary: A narrowly scoped gateway that verifies signed workload tokens, enforces audience policy, and emits privacy-bounded audit decisions.
intended_users: Platform teams connecting short-lived internal workloads across trust zones.

design_decisions.problem_or_constraint: Token format, revocation, replay, and clock-skew decisions compare alternatives and define reconsideration triggers.
design_decisions.alternatives_considered: The committed alternatives table compares benefits, rejected costs, and the condition that triggers reconsideration.
design_decisions.chosen_approach_and_rationale: Verification, authorization, replay control, rate policy, and audit output are isolated behind stable interfaces.
design_decisions.accepted_trade_off: The in-memory replay adapter must be replaced by an atomic shared store for multi-process use.
design_decisions.validation_approach: Reject tokens whose declared algorithm differs from the configured verifier. Reject a valid token that lacks every scope required by the requested operation. Allow only one successful consumption for the same token identifier.
design_decisions.reconsideration_conditions: The in-memory replay adapter must be replaced by an atomic shared store for multi-process use. Key generation and hardware-backed custody remain deployment responsibilities outside this library.

testing_strategy: Committed cross-boundary, negative, and boundary tests: test/adversarial-token.test.js, test/replay-boundary.test.js. Their presence does not establish that they pass in Finch static review.
security_threat: An attacker supplies a malformed or algorithm-confused token to bypass verification. Control: The verifier accepts one explicit algorithm and validates encoding, signature, issuer, audience, and time bounds. A captured valid token is reused within its authorization lifetime. Control: A bounded replay store atomically consumes token identifiers until their expiration boundary.
production_limitation: The in-memory replay adapter must be replaced by an atomic shared store for multi-process use. Key generation and hardware-backed custody remain deployment responsibilities outside this library.
technical_debt: Complete deployment-specific runtime, performance, accessibility, and security evaluation before production use.
track_alignment_explanation: The product primarily prevents authorization bypass, token replay, and privilege escalation at a concrete security boundary.
